subject.title: Feature request: add prefix/list-style skill discovery to ClawHub CLI search

question: Should ClawHub permanently expose exact and prefix modes on the public skill-search API and CLI, with the proposed bounded-result contract?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new public discovery capability, and choosing API mode names, result caps, ordering, and future pagination semantics requires maintainer ownership beyond a mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Sponsor exact and prefix modes
options.body: Adopt the linked PR's explicit modes after confirming the result-cap and ordering contract, then let its merge close this issue.

options.title: Choose a list-oriented API instead
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a dedicated paginated registry-listing endpoint or CLI surface rather than extending ranked search.

options.title: Keep ranked search only
options.body: Close the linked PR and document `explore` plus `inspect` as the supported discovery model if deterministic namespace enumeration is intentionally out of scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor exact and prefix modes
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked PR's explicit modes after confirming the result-cap and ordering contract, then let its merge close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active implementation proposal and can clarify its API and CLI contract, though a repository product owner must make the final direction decision.
